meta.name: Palestine Is Still The Issue
meta.description: John Pilger returns to the Occupied Territories of the West Bank and Gaza where, in 1974, he filmed a documentary with the same title —Palestine Is Still The Issue— a film about the same issues, a nation of people, the Palestinians, forced off their land and subjected to military occupation by Israel. This is an occupation condemned by the United Nations and almost every country in the world, including Britain. But Israel is backed by a very powerful friend, the United States.
